plan.title: Reject surrogate bid with rebidding allowed

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the event.
Confirm the opened event is in an evaluation-related state.
Open the RFQ responses view containing Vendor A's bid.
Open rejection for Vendor A's bid.
Confirm the rejection dialog opened.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog identifies Vendor A's bid.
Enter the required rejection reason.
Allow Vendor A to submit a new bid after rejection.
Submit the rejection.
Verify the rejection reason is displayed after confirmation.
Open the RFQ Rejected Bids view.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the rejected-bid record contains the exact remark.
Return to the comparison grid to verify the rejected bid no longer determines the ranking.
Verify the rejected Vendor A bid is absent from the active QCS vendor columns and Vendor B remains active.
Verify Vendor B moves to rank 1 after Vendor A's rejection.
Open the supplier portal as Vendor A to verify the vendor-facing rejection.
Open the event's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A can see the rejection reason.
Return to the buyer session to reopen bidding.
Reopen the RFQ submission window so the allowed rebid can be attempted.
Return to Vendor A's supplier session for the rebid.
Open the reopened pricing round.
Submit a new bid as Vendor A after the rejection.
Verify the rebid was accepted and submitted.
